title: 883 Trial with high volume of messages
body:
Supports #883 

The wargame has around 150 messages. But some clients are take 5 seconds to respond.

I've created a mock wargame with a high number of messages (180). They are simpler than the ones the users currently have, but they are enough to display the desired behaviour.

It can take several seconds to change tabs.

Here is a link to white game control, notice the lag in changing channels: https://serge-complex-messages-fbernb2.herokuapp.com/?wargame=wargame-kqgy546g&access=pkoiqu5ev

Here is a link to red-2, which isn't in any high-volume channels: https://serge-complex-messages-fbernb2.herokuapp.com/?wargame=wargame-kqgy546g&access=p3d3n

issues.title: Performance impact with over 150 messages
issues.body:
The users have a wargame with around 150 messages. Some are up to a page long.

The client can be unresponsive at times.  The clock only moves forward once every 9 seconds.  It can take 5 seconds to switch tabs.

When they type, it can take a few seconds before text starts to appear.

I've mocked up a similar scenario: `CMDWK-HIGH DATA`

Here is the clock. Notice sometimes is jumps two seconds:
![screencast](https://i.gyazo.com/5d9e4bf7304fc31bb8c9fbc22e23c587.gif)

My _gut-feeling_ is that the UI is re-rendering on each clock-tick.

Here is the delay when switching between tabs:
![switch between tabs](https://i.gyazo.com/7f78bcb7f6f7a91ab243f25a82f41f80.gif)

I've just tried typing in a long message, one second at a time. There is a pause in the typing once every 5 seconds.
![delay in processing text chars](https://i.gyazo.com/c87bf52ed934b3ddc5752c9a101b8efb.gif)

Aah, that delay may be related.  When we open the app, there is a delay of 1-2 seconds while it renders the channels on the left-hand side.  If the _heartbeat_ causes it all to re-render, then that would introduce a further delay.  _maybe_ once there are enough messages it can take more than 5 seconds, causing the re-renders to stack up.
![pause on load](https://i.gyazo.com/59eaf91c4574ac19676f866198cba144.gif)

Here is a link to white game control, notice the lag in changing channels: https://serge-review.herokuapp.com/?wargame=wargame-kqgy546g&access=pkoiqu5ev

Here is a link to red-2, which isn't in any high-volume channels: https://serge-review.herokuapp.com/?wargame=wargame-kqgy546g&access=p3d3n
